title: Grade 6 French — Tue, Jun 10
description: Les sports et les loisirs — Day 2 of 5: Sports vocabulary
subject: french

questions.question: What is 'le football' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Le football' = football/soccer. 'Je joue au football.' = I play football.

questions.question: How do you say 'swimming' in French?
questions.explanation: 'La natation' = swimming. 'Je fais de la natation.' = I do/go swimming.

questions.question: What is 'le cricket' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le cricket' = cricket. The word is the same in French! 'Je joue au cricket.' = I play cricket.

questions.question: How do you say 'cycling' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le cyclisme' or 'le vélo' = cycling. 'Je fais du vélo.' = I cycle.

questions.question: What is 'la danse' in English?
questions.explanation: 'La danse' = dance. 'Je fais de la danse.' = I do dancing.

questions.question: How do you say 'tennis' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Le tennis' = tennis. 'Je joue au tennis.' = I play tennis.

questions.question: What is 'le ski' in English?
questions.explanation: 'Le ski' = skiing. 'Je fais du ski en hiver.' = I go skiing in winter.

questions.question: How do you say 'I play basketball' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je joue au basket-ball.' = I play basketball. Team sport → 'jouer à'.

questions.question: What is 'la course à pied' in English?
questions.explanation: 'La course à pied' = running (on foot). 'Je fais de la course à pied.' = I go running.

questions.question: How do you say 'I do yoga' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Je fais du yoga.' = I do yoga. Individual activity → 'faire de'.

questions.question: Translate: 'She plays volleyball on Saturdays.'
options: Elle joue au volley-ball le samedi.
Elle fait du volley-ball le samedi.
Elle joue du volley-ball le samedi.
questions.explanation: 'Elle joue au volley-ball le samedi.' = She plays volleyball on Saturdays. Team sport → 'jouer à'.

questions.question: Complete: 'Mon sport préféré est ___.' (My favourite sport is swimming.)
questions.explanation: 'Mon sport préféré est la natation.' = My favourite sport is swimming. After 'est' use definite article.

questions.question: Translate: 'We do gymnastics three times a week.'
options: Nous faisons de la gymnastique trois fois par semaine.
Nous jouons à la gymnastique trois fois.
Nous faisons la gymnasique trois fois une semaine.
Nous aimons faire de la gymnasique.
questions.explanation: 'Nous faisons de la gymnastique trois fois par semaine.' = We do gymnastics three times a week.

questions.question: What does 'le terrain de sport' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le terrain de sport' = the sports field / sports ground. 'Nous jouons au foot sur le terrain.' = We play football on the pitch.

questions.question: How do you say 'Sport is good for health' in French?
options: Le sport est bon pour la santé.
Je fais du sport pour le plaisir.
questions.explanation: 'Le sport est bon pour la santé.' = Sport is good for health. 'La santé' = health.
